hook: ChatGPT keeps explaining things to you like you're new here.
caption:
ChatGPT keeps explaining things to you like you're new here.

You asked for help restructuring your pitch deck.

It gave you a paragraph about what a pitch deck is.

You've raised two rounds. You know what a pitch deck is.

This is the AI equivalent of someone answering 'how was your day?' with a definition of the word 'day.'

The problem isn't the model. The problem is the model has no idea who it's talking to.

It doesn't know you've been in sales for 12 years.
It doesn't know you think in frameworks, not feelings.
It doesn't know you want the brutal honest version, not the diplomatic one.

So it defaults to: explain everything, hedge everything, soften everything.

For everyone.

BootFile fixes this by building a profile of how YOU actually think — your experience level, your communication style, how you process information, what you find condescending.

Then every AI interaction starts from THAT baseline instead of from zero.

Stop getting talked down to by software.

Link in bio to build your profile.
